Problem Description
: SECC errors
Troubleshooting

I can see SECC errors occurring on the charger, I request you to please check the SECC KF11 connections. Please check all the DI, DO, CAN and the 24V supply to the SECC -KF11 (attached in the image).
If the connections are found ok, please also carry a spare SECC2300 and ethernet cables and check with the spare parts.
8EM5903-0AA00-6AA3 → -KF11 SECC Charge Controller CCS2 CHAdeMO AC
For future reference, your case number is
0407255
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
